description: Lint an LLM tool/function-calling definition (OpenAI, Anthropic, or MCP format — a single definition, an array of them, or a {tools:[...]} wrapper) for mistakes that measurably hurt model accuracy: a missing or vague description, an invalid tool name, a non-object top-level parameter schema, properties missing descriptions, an empty enum, a "required" entry with no matching property, or duplicate tool names.

schema.description: JSON text: a single tool definition, an array of them, or a {tools:[...]} wrapper, in OpenAI/Anthropic/MCP format

name: lint_tool_schema
